expectation: Cytoplasmic fibrous stain of smooth muscle, myofibroblasts and pericytes: rings round vessels, muscularis layers in gut wall, thin lamina/muscularis mucosae lines and villus core myofibroblasts; epithelium and most stromal cells negative.
notes: aSMA is bright in the muscularis propria, in a continuous line of muscularis mucosae, in many vessel rings in the submucosa and in thin strands in the cores of mucosal folds. The epithelium is negative. This is a textbook smooth muscle pattern.
observed: A: bright muscularis propria bands, continuous muscularis mucosae lines, many vessel rings across stroma, thin strands in villus cores; epithelium dark. B,C: epithelial fields, mostly negative (one bright edge in B). D: fibrous cytoplasmic wall around nuclei.
why: aSMA marks muscle layers, vessel walls and fold-core myofibroblasts with sharp specificity, and the epithelium stays negative, as smooth-muscle actin should.
